scope: batch snapshot for the shapes 3,4,5,7,8,9,10,11,12,13 calibration run
purpose: owner-side pre-calibration machine snapshot covering one calibration batch
note: ONE snapshot deliberately shared across a calibration batch, so machine_state_sha256 is identical for every shape in it. This is the owner-side supplementary record only; the AUTHORITATIVE per-run machine state is captured independently by the trusted controller inside each run (controller_machine_state.json, its own sha) and differs run to run. Desktop residents only, no benchmark/audit/controller process live at capture. SM clock reads 450 MHz idle and boosts under load; calibration is a within-invocation baseline-vs-baseline ratio, so idle clock state does not bias it (LESSONS 11).
